story_type: tsunami surge tearing through a harbor, seen from a Coast Guard helicopter
hook: A tsunami from Japan reached this California harbor.
narration: The earthquake was in Japan. The tsunami it made reached all the way to this harbor in California.
An eight point nine earthquake had struck Japan, and its waves crossed the Pacific to the West Coast.
A Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station Humboldt Bay flew over Crescent City to check the shoreline.
Below them the harbor was churning. Whole sections of dock had broken loose and were drifting between the boats.
[short pause] A tsunami comes in as a surge. The water floods into a harbor and drains back out, over and over, for hours.
outcome: Four days later, crews were still raising sunken boats out of Crescent City Harbor.
title: Tsunami from Japan hits a California harbor
description:
On March 11, 2011, a Coast Guard Air Station Humboldt Bay aircrew flew over Crescent City, California, noting damage to docks and piers from the tsunami caused by the earthquake that struck Japan.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Humboldt Bay, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/316769/tsunami-damage-shorelines-crescent-city-calif
